name: SecureInput MCP
description: Local-first MCP server that collects API keys, passwords, and tokens in an inline MCP App form or a paired 127.0.0.1 browser page instead of the chat, then delivers them to a local command through stdin or environment variables, or writes them to a .env file. request_secret and submit_inline_secret lead to command execution or .env writes and require review; status, check, and cancel tools inherit Guard policy. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Keep request_secret on Review: its delivery block names the command, arguments, working directory, or .env path that will receive the value. Check that destination before approving.
Use the paired browser input mode (secureinput settings --input-mode browser) to see SecureInput's own destination and risk review; the compact inline form submits on Enter.
Leave return delivery disabled (the default) so secret values are not sent back in MCP tool results.
Start the daemon with secureinput serve --root <project-dir> (repeatable) so commands and .env writes stay inside the intended project directories; the default allowed root is the home directory.
